# Pandamonium v1.0.70

Normal chat now retains relevant published skill procedures for requests outside its built-in intent categories. This repairs the soundboard discovery gap reported after v1.0.69. Rollback is signed v1.0.69 with the updater snapshot.

## MAD-968 — Myinstants: give Jarvis a soundboard with favorites and response-positioned audio

### Problem

Soundboard Settings worked, but ordinary Jarvis chat had no soundboard usage skill. Even after adding one, unknown-domain requests discarded its procedure and could produce a capability claim or an emoji without executing a soundboard tool.

### Implementation

The shared agent loop checks the owner's published skills before taking the low-signal shortcut. A relevant match retains normal skill injection and tool discovery. Greetings, disabled Skills preferences, foreign-owner skills and explicit guide-only restrictions retain their existing boundaries. A versioned soundboard skill recipe documents plugin inspection, native tool mounting, favorites/search and exact response cue placement.

### Product value and UI visibility

Jarvis can receive the soundboard procedure in normal chat and use the installed plugin to retrieve saved sounds. Text sound cues remain manual play buttons; voice uses the existing player and timing implementation.

### Verification

The original installed normal-chat failure was reproduced, including a saved-sound request that returned an emoji without a native soundboard call. Focused regression checks cover both user requests, the Skills off switch, owner isolation and greetings. Existing skill trust-boundary and extension mounting checks pass. Required CI and signed updater verification remain enforced. Installed model/tool execution results are recorded separately in MAD-968; recognition alone is not execution proof.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

No new dependency, database schema, model or fallback changes. The soundboard recipe is published separately through the existing owner-scoped Skills manager; it is not automatically installed by this app update or added to the signed Myinstants 1.1.1 package. Existing installations must publish the recipe for their intended owner. The shared fix applies to all matching published skills. Cache427 delivers the release identity. Provider search failures still surface normally.
